PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Stops the simulation of grids if far away from all online players
PluginData.Description:
Concealment reduces server load by pausing grid groups far from online players and revealing them when players return. Timers, programmable blocks and thrusters pause while concealed.
Resource-limited catch-up is enabled by default for standalone Magnetar. Production, grid power and active safe zones share finite energy, fuel, gas, materials and upkeep budgets. Compensation is capped at 72 hours by default and is configurable. Existing legacy boost banks drain separately.
Admins configure distances, scan intervals, production modes, exclusions and dynamic block rules through Quasar. In Cluster mode all autonomous Concealment mechanisms are disabled; Cluster owns partition offlining and wake-up.
Commands: !conceal run, !conceal reveal, !conceal reveal all, !conceal on and !conceal off.
Inspired by the original Torch plugin: https://github.com/TorchAPI/Concealment
